title: The CDC says experts reviewed data and chose the milestone items
summary: The CDC credits subject matter experts with reviewing data and selecting the developmental milestones on these lists.
body: The acknowledgments on the CDC's nine-month page thank subject matter experts who contributed to the review of data and the selection of developmental milestones. The items are an expert-chosen set. The page says the information was reviewed on 16 May 2026. It does not present the list as a measurement taken on every child in the country.

sources.title: Milestones by 9 Months
sources.author: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
sources.note: US CDC page, public domain. Updated and reviewed 16 May 2026. Supports the acknowledgment that experts contributed to review of data and selection of the milestones, and the reviewed date.
